title: Finite-dimensional quotient model for top coherent cohomology
statement: Let k be a field and X a separated finite-type k-scheme of topological Krull dimension d. For every coherent O_X-module F, the projective-closure construction supplies a proper surjective modification π : Y → X and, after choosing a finite basis of the finite-dimensional projective top cohomology, a surjective k-linear map from (Fin n → k) onto H^d(X, F), where the k-action on cohomology is restriction along k → Γ(X, O_X).

source.place: Tag 0A3M, proof of lemma-top-cohomology-coherent, projective closure and top-degree restriction

proof.text: Apply Chow modification and projective closure to obtain a finite-dimensional projective top-cohomology source. The top-degree restriction map is surjective, and Leray comparison identifies its target with the displayed cohomology. Choose a finite basis of the source and transport the surjection along the resulting linear equivalence to obtain a map from `Fin n → k`.

theorem exists_finiteDimensional_top_coherent_cohomology_quotient
    (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] (d : ℕ)
    (hd : topologicalKrullDim X = (d : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (F : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
    (hF : RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace F) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ f : (Fin n → k) →ₗ[k]
      ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars
          ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv ≫
            (X ↘ Spec (.of k)).appTop).hom).obj
        ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace d).obj F)),
      Function.Surjective f ∧
        ∃ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (π : Y ⟶ X), IsProper π ∧ Surjective π
